"""Execute only the nine pinned public probes in their original namespace."""
from contextlib import ExitStack, contextmanager
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def require(condition, reason):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(reason)


def identity(info):
    return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_uid, info.st_gid,
            info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns, info.st_nlink)


def regular_bytes(path):
    path = Path(path)
    require(path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts, "absolute input required")
    descriptors = [os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)]
    parents = []
    try:
        parent = descriptors[-1]
        for component in path.parts[1:-1]:
            located = os.stat(component, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            fd = os.open(component, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            descriptors.append(fd)
            actual = os.fstat(fd)
            require((actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino, actual.st_mode, actual.st_uid) ==
                    (located.st_dev, located.st_ino, located.st_mode, located.st_uid), "input parent changed")
            parents.append((parent, component, fd))
            parent = fd
        located = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        fd = os.open(path.name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=parent)
        descriptors.append(fd)
        actual = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(actual.st_mode) and actual.st_nlink == 1 and identity(actual) == identity(located),
                "input file changed")
        body = bytearray()
        while block := os.read(fd, 1024 * 1024):
            body.extend(block)
        require(len(body) == actual.st_size and identity(actual) == identity(os.fstat(fd)) ==
                identity(os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)), "input file changed")
        for parent, component, fd in parents:
            actual, located = os.fstat(fd), os.stat(component, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            require((actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino, actual.st_mode, actual.st_uid) ==
                    (located.st_dev, located.st_ino, located.st_mode, located.st_uid), "input parent changed")
        return bytes(body)
    finally:
        for fd in reversed(descriptors):
            os.close(fd)


def json_bytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()


def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()


def write_fresh(path, body):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        offset = 0
        while offset < len(body):
            offset += os.write(fd, body[offset:])
        os.fsync(fd)
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o444)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


APPROVED_AUTHORIZATION_SHA256 = "90659258cf73681a01780b0e83018bd418b1cbf3207fa29c2e0454af0a5bac41"
MAX_LAUNCHER_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024


def approved_public_plan(plan, authorization_path):
    """Bind only the independently approved fixture bytes and command substitutions."""
    body = regular_bytes(authorization_path)
    require(sha(body) == APPROVED_AUTHORIZATION_SHA256
            and plan.get("authorization_sha256") == APPROVED_AUTHORIZATION_SHA256,
            "public authorization table differs")
    approved = json.loads(body)
    candidate = Path(plan["candidate"])
    require(plan.get("schema") == "chio.public-linux-primary-plan.v2", "bound primary plan required")
    require(len(plan["configs"]) == len(approved["cases"]), "approved probe denominator differs")
    for row, contract in zip(plan["configs"], approved["cases"]):
        configuration = candidate / contract["configuration_relative_path"]
        command = [argument.replace("{candidate}", str(candidate)).replace("{configuration}", str(configuration))
                   for argument in contract["command_template"]]
        require(row["name"] == contract["name"] and row["guest_path"] == str(configuration)
                and row["command"] == command, "unapproved public probe command or configuration path")
    def check_payloads():
        for payload in approved["payloads"]:
            data = regular_bytes(candidate / payload["path"])
            require(len(data) == payload["size"] and sha(data) == payload["sha256"],
                    "unapproved public probe payload")
    check_payloads()
    return check_payloads


def directory_identity(info):
    return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_uid, info.st_gid)


class LauncherCapture:
    """Hash closed child output through the same held log descriptors."""
    def __init__(self, case, parent, streams, parents):
        self.case, self.parent, self.streams, self.parents = case, parent, streams, parents
        self.measurements = {}

    def validate(self):
        for parent, component, descriptor, bound in self.parents:
            require(directory_identity(os.fstat(descriptor)) == bound
                    and directory_identity(os.stat(component, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)) == bound,
                    "launcher capture parent changed")
        for name, bound in self.measurements.items():
            stream = self.streams[name]
            actual = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            located = os.stat("launcher." + name + ".log", dir_fd=self.parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            require(identity(actual) == bound == identity(located), "completed launcher capture changed")

    def complete(self):
        captured = {}
        for name, stream in self.streams.items():
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o444)
            actual = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            located = os.stat("launcher." + name + ".log", dir_fd=self.parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            require(stat.S_ISREG(actual.st_mode) and actual.st_uid == os.getuid() and actual.st_nlink == 1
                    and identity(actual) == identity(located) and actual.st_size <= MAX_LAUNCHER_BYTES,
                    "launcher capture is replaced, symbolic or oversized")
            os.lseek(stream.fileno(), 0, os.SEEK_SET)
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            size = 0
            while block := os.read(stream.fileno(), 1024 * 1024):
                size += len(block)
                require(size <= MAX_LAUNCHER_BYTES, "launcher capture exceeds byte limit")
                digest.update(block)
            require(size == actual.st_size and identity(actual) == identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) ==
                    identity(os.stat("launcher." + name + ".log", dir_fd=self.parent, follow_symlinks=False)),
                    "launcher capture changed during readback")
            self.measurements[name] = identity(actual)
            captured[name] = {"path": str(self.case / ("launcher." + name + ".log")),
                              "sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "size": size}
        self.validate()
        return captured


@contextmanager
def held_launcher_logs(case):
    """Create and retain log ancestry and leaves without following any link."""
    case = Path(case)
    require(case.is_absolute() and ".." not in case.parts, "absolute launcher case required")
    descriptors = [os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)]
    parents = []
    streams = {}
    guard = None
    try:
        parent = descriptors[-1]
        for component in case.parts[1:]:
            located = os.stat(component, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            descriptor = os.open(component, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK,
                                 dir_fd=parent)
            descriptors.append(descriptor)
            opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
            bound = directory_identity(opened)
            require(stat.S_ISDIR(opened.st_mode) and bound == directory_identity(located),
                    "launcher capture directory changed")
            parents.append((parent, component, descriptor, bound))
            parent = descriptor
        metadata = os.fstat(parent)
        require(metadata.st_uid == os.getuid() and stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) == 0o700,
                "launcher case is not private and owned")
        for name in ("stdout", "stderr"):
            descriptor = os.open("launcher." + name + ".log",
                os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, 0o600, dir_fd=parent)
            streams[name] = os.fdopen(descriptor, "w+b")
        guard = LauncherCapture(case, parent, streams, parents)
        yield streams["stdout"], streams["stderr"], guard
        guard.validate()
    finally:
        for stream in reversed(list(streams.values())):
            stream.close()
        for descriptor in reversed(descriptors):
            os.close(descriptor)


class LauncherObservation:
    """Retain the actual process observation through audit and result publication."""
    def __init__(self, path, descriptor, launcher, body):
        self.path, self.descriptor, self.launcher = path, descriptor, launcher
        self.bound = identity(os.fstat(descriptor))
        require(stat.S_ISREG(self.bound[2]) and self.bound[3] == os.getuid()
                and stat.S_IMODE(self.bound[2]) == 0o444 and self.bound[-1] == 1
                and self.bound[5] == len(body), "launcher observation is not an owned sealed regular file")
        os.lseek(descriptor, 0, os.SEEK_SET)
        readback = bytearray()
        while block := os.read(descriptor, 65536):
            readback.extend(block)
            require(len(readback) <= 1024 * 1024, "launcher observation exceeds byte limit")
        require(bytes(readback) == body, "launcher observation readback differs")
        self.validate()
        self.capture = {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha(bytes(readback)), "size": len(readback)}

    def validate(self):
        self.launcher.validate()
        require(identity(os.fstat(self.descriptor)) == self.bound ==
                identity(os.stat(self.path.name, dir_fd=self.launcher.parent, follow_symlinks=False)),
                "completed launcher observation changed")


@contextmanager
def held_launcher_observation(case, launcher, value):
    """Publish a fresh observation without releasing its original file or ancestry."""
    body = json_bytes(value)
    require(len(body) <= 1024 * 1024 and case == launcher.case,
            "launcher observation location or size differs")
    launcher.validate()
    path = case / "launcher-observation.json"
    descriptor = os.open(path.name, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK,
                         0o600, dir_fd=launcher.parent)
    try:
        offset = 0
        while offset < len(body):
            written = os.write(descriptor, body[offset:])
            require(written > 0, "launcher observation write made no progress")
            offset += written
        os.fsync(descriptor)
        os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o444)
        observation = LauncherObservation(path, descriptor, launcher, body)
        yield observation
        observation.validate()
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def stop_owned_child(process):
    """Stop only the still-owned process group and reap it within the existing drain limits."""
    if process.poll() is not None:
        return
    try:
        require(os.getpgid(process.pid) == process.pid, "owned process group changed")
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        require(process.poll() is not None, "owned process group disappeared before child exit")
        return
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        require(process.poll() is None and os.getpgid(process.pid) == process.pid,
                "owned process group changed before forced stop")
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait(timeout=5)


class OwnedChildLifecycle:
    """Attempt the existing bounded drain once and retain an unresolved outcome."""
    def __init__(self, result):
        self.process = None
        self.result = result
        self.observation = None

    def stop(self):
        if self.process is None or self.observation is not None:
            return self.observation
        observed = self.process.poll()
        self.observation = {"status": "REAPED" if observed is not None else "FAILED/UNKNOWN",
                            "attempted": observed is None, "observed_exit": observed}
        self.result["owned_child_cleanup"] = self.observation
        if observed is None:
            try:
                stop_owned_child(self.process)
            except Exception as error:
                self.observation["reason"] = type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)
            else:
                observed = self.process.poll()
                if observed is not None:
                    self.observation.update(status="REAPED", observed_exit=observed)
                else:
                    self.observation["reason"] = "Owned child exit was not observed after the bounded drain"
        if self.result["actual_exit"] is None:
            self.result["actual_exit"] = self.observation["observed_exit"]
        return self.observation


def main():
    require(len(sys.argv) == 4, "plan, pin and approved public authorization required")
    plan_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
    plan_body = regular_bytes(plan_path)
    require(sha(plan_body) == sys.argv[2], "campaign plan changed")
    plan = json.loads(plan_body)
    candidate = Path(plan["candidate"])
    expected_uid = plan.get("expected_uid")
    require(type(expected_uid) is int and expected_uid >= 0 and os.getuid() == expected_uid
            and candidate.parent == Path("/var/tmp") and plan["source_location"]["root"]["uid"] == expected_uid,
            "wrong campaign owner")
    require(plan["caps"] == {"total_seconds": 900, "ordinary_seconds": 120, "compiler_seconds": 180, "retry": False},
            "campaign bounds differ")
    names = ["allowed-read", "outside-read", "outside-write", "evidence-read", "evidence-write", "network",
             "forged-ipc", "gnu-native", "musl-static-pie"]
    require([row["name"] for row in plan["configs"]] == names, "probe denominator differs")
    check_payloads = approved_public_plan(plan, Path(sys.argv[3]))
    output = candidate / "target/metadata/primary-observations"
    os.mkdir(output, 0o700)
    environment = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(candidate / "target/write/home"),
                   "LC_ALL": "C", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null"}
    for image in plan["tools"]:
        require(sha(regular_bytes(image["path"])) == image["sha256"], "campaign tool changed")
    expected_inventory = json.loads(regular_bytes(candidate / "target/metadata/runtime-inventory.json"))
    receipt = json.loads(regular_bytes(candidate / "target/metadata/materialization.json"))
    require(receipt["source_location"] == plan["source_location"], "candidate location differs")
    def check_source():
        check_payloads()
        metadata = os.stat(candidate, follow_symlinks=False)
        root = plan["source_location"]["root"]
        require((metadata.st_dev, metadata.st_ino, metadata.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode)) ==
                (root["device"], root["inode"], root["uid"], root["mode"]), "candidate location changed")
        for row in receipt["source_files"]:
            body = regular_bytes(row["path"])
            info = os.stat(row["path"], follow_symlinks=False)
            require(sha(body) == row["sha256"] and (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)) ==
                    (row["device"], row["inode"], row["uid"], row["mode"]), "public source changed")
    def capture_inventory(path, timeout):
        argv = ["/usr/bin/python3.12", "-I", "-B", str(candidate / "target/metadata/inventory-collector.py"),
                "--inventory", "--source-root", str(candidate)]
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=candidate, env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
        write_fresh(path, result.stdout)
        write_fresh(path.with_suffix(".stderr.log"), result.stderr)
        require(result.returncode == 0 and json.loads(result.stdout) == expected_inventory, "actual source inventory differs")
        return {"command": argv, "actual_exit": result.returncode, "path": str(path), "sha256": sha(result.stdout)}

    check_source()
    outside = candidate / "target/outside-public"
    os.mkdir(outside, 0o700)
    write_fresh(outside / "allowed-input.txt", b"PUBLIC-ALLOWED-READ\n")
    unconfined = {"read_bytes": regular_bytes(outside / "allowed-input.txt").decode("ascii")}
    feasibility = outside / "unconfined-write-control"
    fd = os.open(feasibility, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    os.write(fd, b"PUBLIC-UNCONFINED-WRITE\n")
    os.fsync(fd)
    unconfined["written_size"] = os.fstat(fd).st_size
    os.close(fd)
    os.unlink(feasibility)
    require(not feasibility.exists() and unconfined["read_bytes"] == "PUBLIC-ALLOWED-READ\n" and unconfined["written_size"] == len(b"PUBLIC-UNCONFINED-WRITE\n"),
            "unconfined feasibility failed")
    write_fresh(output / "unconfined-feasibility.json", json_bytes({"actual_exit": 0, "observed": unconfined,
        "outside_path": str(outside), "compiler_dispatched": False, "qualified": False}))
    started = None
    results = []
    cleanup_incomplete = False
    for row in plan["configs"]:
        result = {"name": row["name"], "command": row["command"], "actual_exit": None,
                  "status": "not-executed", "qualified": False, "compiled_closure_status": "not-established"}
        if cleanup_incomplete or (started is not None and time.monotonic() - started >= 900):
            result["reason"] = "owned-child-cleanup-incomplete" if cleanup_incomplete else "common-deadline-exhausted"
            results.append(result)
            write_fresh(output / (row["name"] + ".result.json"), json_bytes(result))
            print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
            continue
        case = output / row["name"]
        os.mkdir(case, 0o700)
        custody = ExitStack()
        launcher_guard = None
        observation_guard = None
        process = None
        child_lifecycle = OwnedChildLifecycle(result)
        try:
            try:
                check_source()
                require(sha(regular_bytes(row["guest_path"])) == row["sha256"], "configuration changed")
                before = capture_inventory(case / "runtime-before.json", min(60, 900 - (time.monotonic() - started)) if started else 60)
                child_command = row["command"][row["command"].index("--") + 1:]
                command_path = case / "command.json"
                write_fresh(command_path, json_bytes(child_command))
                cap = 180 if row["name"] in {"gnu-native", "musl-static-pie"} else 120
                if started is None:
                    started = time.monotonic()
                    write_fresh(output / "dispatch-start.json", json_bytes({"schema": "chio.public-probe-dispatch-start.v1",
                        "unix_seconds": time.time(), "monotonic_seconds": started, "caps": plan["caps"],
                        "plan_sha256": sha(plan_body), "candidate": str(candidate), "source_binding": plan["source_binding"]}))
                remaining = 900 - (time.monotonic() - started)
                require(remaining > 0, "common deadline exhausted")
                bound = min(cap, remaining)
                command_started = time.monotonic()
                stdout, stderr, launcher_guard = custody.enter_context(held_launcher_logs(case))
                process = subprocess.Popen(row["command"], cwd=candidate, env=environment, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
                child_lifecycle.process = process
                result.update(status="running", pid=process.pid, process_group=process.pid, command_timeout_seconds=bound)
                print(json.dumps({"name": row["name"], "status": "running", "pid": process.pid,
                    "command_timeout_seconds": bound, "common_remaining_seconds": remaining}), flush=True)
                try:
                    wait_remaining = bound - (time.monotonic() - command_started)
                    require(wait_remaining > 0, "command deadline exhausted during spawn")
                    result["actual_exit"] = process.wait(timeout=wait_remaining)
                    result["status"] = "passed-command" if result["actual_exit"] == 0 else "failed-command"
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    result["status"] = "timed-out"
                    result["timeout_seconds"] = bound
                    cleanup = child_lifecycle.stop()
                    require(cleanup["status"] == "REAPED", "owned child cleanup incomplete")
                    result["actual_exit"] = process.returncode
                stdout.flush()
                stderr.flush()
                os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
                os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
                result["launcher_capture"] = launcher_guard.complete()
                result["elapsed_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - command_started
                observation = {"schema": "chio.public-linux-launcher-observation.v1", "candidate": str(candidate),
                    "source_binding": plan["source_binding"], "name": row["name"], "command": row["command"],
                    "actual_exit": result["actual_exit"], "command_timeout_seconds": bound,
                    "elapsed_seconds": result["elapsed_seconds"], "pid": result["pid"],
                    "process_group": result["process_group"], "launcher_capture": result["launcher_capture"]}
                observation_guard = custody.enter_context(held_launcher_observation(case, launcher_guard, observation))
                result["launcher_observation"] = observation_guard.capture
                result["runtime_before"] = before
                remaining = 900 - (time.monotonic() - started)
                require(remaining > 0, "common deadline exhausted before source and original-namespace audit")
                result["runtime_after"] = capture_inventory(case / "runtime-after.json", min(60, remaining))
                check_source()
                scopes = sorted(Path(row["guest_path"]).parents[1].joinpath("evidence", row["name"]).glob("*/scope.json"))
                require(len(scopes) == 1, "one completed original scope required")
                audit = ["/usr/bin/python3.12", "-I", "-B", str(candidate / "target/metadata/consumer/verify_public_compilation_probes.py"),
                    "--auditor", str(candidate / "target/metadata/inventory-collector.py"), "--scope", str(scopes[0]),
                    "--runtime-before", str(case / "runtime-before.json"), "--runtime-after", str(case / "runtime-after.json"),
                    "--command", str(command_path), "--launcher-observation", str(case / "launcher-observation.json"),
                    "--authorization", str(candidate / "target/metadata/public-probe-authorization.json")]
                remaining = 900 - (time.monotonic() - started)
                require(remaining > 0, "common deadline exhausted before original-namespace audit")
                audit_result = subprocess.run(audit, cwd=candidate, env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=remaining, check=False)
                write_fresh(case / "original-namespace-audit.stdout.json", audit_result.stdout)
                write_fresh(case / "original-namespace-audit.stderr.log", audit_result.stderr)
                result["original_namespace_audit"] = {"command": audit, "actual_exit": audit_result.returncode,
                    "stdout_sha256": sha(audit_result.stdout), "stderr_sha256": sha(audit_result.stderr), "scope": str(scopes[0])}
                if audit_result.returncode != 0:
                    result["status"] = "failed-original-namespace-audit"
                elif result["actual_exit"] == 0:
                    result["status"] = "passed-command-and-original-namespace-audit"
                require(time.monotonic() - started <= 900, "common deadline exhausted during original-namespace audit")
                require(not (outside / "fresh-output").exists(), "outside unauthorized output exists")
                if row["name"] == "evidence-write":
                    require(not scopes[0].with_name("unauthorized-write.json").exists(), "protected unauthorized output exists")
            except Exception as error:
                result["status"] = "failed-observation" if result["status"] not in {"timed-out", "failed-command"} else result["status"]
                result["observation_error"] = type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)
            finally:
                child_lifecycle.stop()
            if child_lifecycle.observation is not None and child_lifecycle.observation["status"] == "FAILED/UNKNOWN":
                cleanup_incomplete = True
                result["status"] = "failed-owned-child-cleanup"
            if launcher_guard is not None:
                launcher_guard.validate()
            if observation_guard is not None:
                observation_guard.validate()
            results.append(result)
            write_fresh(output / (row["name"] + ".result.json"), json_bytes(result))
        finally:
            try:
                child_lifecycle.stop()
            finally:
                custody.close()
        print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started if started else None
    status = "passed-public-microprobes" if elapsed is not None and elapsed <= 900 and all(
        r["status"] == "passed-command-and-original-namespace-audit" for r in results) else "failed-public-microprobes"
    write_fresh(output / "result.json", json_bytes({"schema": "chio.public-linux-primary-result.v2",
        "authorization_sha256": APPROVED_AUTHORIZATION_SHA256, "expected_uid": expected_uid,
        "status": status, "results": results, "caps": plan["caps"],
        "candidate": str(candidate), "source_binding": plan["source_binding"], "qualified": False,
        "compiled_closure_status": "not-established", "artifacts_exported": False,
        "elapsed_from_first_dispatch_seconds": elapsed}))
    print(json.dumps({"status": status, "actual_completed_cases": sum(r["actual_exit"] is not None for r in results),
        "original_namespace_audits_passed": sum(r.get("original_namespace_audit", {}).get("actual_exit") == 0 for r in results),
        "qualified": False, "artifacts_exported": False}), flush=True)
    return 0 if status == "passed-public-microprobes" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
